insert.links.zoom.note: U:prism/zoom: each entry opens its own checklist. The zoom is a picture of the slide that jumps to it in the show (Return to Zoom: on for section and summary zooms); the picture is the slide drawn by the app, or a plain page with its title where nothing can draw it. PowerPoint's zoom styles, background and transitions are not in deckcraft and are not offered.
